create_pca_color: create PCA-based point cloud colors from features using get_pca_color with brightness and centering options
load_sonata_model: load the facebook/sonata point cloud model with optional flash attention support
transform_point_cloud: transform point cloud data using sonata's default transform pipeline
run_inference_on_point_cloud: run sonata model inference on point cloud features with torch.inference_mode
visualize_point_cloud: visualize point cloud with PCA colors using open3d draw_geometries
